statement.text: An ''orientation'' of a hypergraph is a [[directed hypergraph]] obtained by choosing a single head-node in each hyperedge. We call a set of orientations of a hypergraph '''head-disjoint''' if none of the hyperedges have the same head-node in two of them. When does a 3-uniform hypergraph admit three head-disjoint strongly connected orientations?
